description: This PHP source file defines the class ModuleClass, which extends CRMEntity, representing a module related to 'payslip' records in the vtiger CRM system. It includes properties for database table configurations, list view settings, search and sort parameters, methods for query generation, security controls, import/export functionalities, and event handlers for module lifecycle events.

classes.name: ModuleClass
classes.description: Represents the 'Payslip' module in vtiger CRM, handling database interactions, list views, security, import/export, and module lifecycle events.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the module instance with column fields, database connection, and logger.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the current sort order for list views, considering request and session parameters.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Returns the order by field for list views, considering default and user preferences.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Placeholder method for saving module-specific data.

methods.name: getQueryByModuleField
methods.description: Generates a query to retrieve records based on module and field parameters, for popup windows.

methods.name: getListQuery
methods.description: Constructs the main SQL query to fetch list view data, including joins for related modules.

methods.name: getListViewSecurityParameter
methods.description: Generates security-related SQL conditions based on user privileges for list views.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds the SQL query used to export records, respecting permissions and filters.

methods.name: initImport
methods.description: Initializes the instance for importing data into this module.

methods.name: create_import_query
methods.description: Creates the SQL query to retrieve records for import review.

methods.name: undo_import
methods.description: Deletes (soft deletes) the last imported records for a given user and module.

methods.name: transform_export_value
methods.description: Transforms a field value during export; calls parent method.

methods.name: set_import_assigned_user
methods.description: Sets the assigned user for imported records, defaulting to current user if invalid.

methods.name: getDuplicatesQuery
methods.description: Constructs a query to find duplicate records based on specific fields.

methods.name: vtlib_handler
methods.description: Handles module lifecycle events such as post-install, enable, disable, update, and pre-uninstall actions.
